name: banking77_v5
instructions: Which intent best describes this message sent to a digital bank's customer support chat? Choose the single most specific intent. Distinguish carefully between similar intents: what kind of thing is affected (card payment, cash withdrawal, transfer, top-up), and what the problem is (pending, failed, declined, reverted, fee, not recognised, wrong rate).

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer has a new card and asks how to activate/enable/switch on it, or activation fails.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age / age requirement for opening an account, or for children/teens to use the service.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Apple Pay / Google Pay / Apple Watch: using them, adding them, topping up with them, or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Where/which ATMs can be used with the card, finding ATMs, how to withdraw cash (general ATM availability, not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: setting it up, finding the option, limits/settings of automatic top-up, adding money automatically at intervals, how to top up while traveling automatically.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer made a bank transfer (e.g. from a UK account, from abroad, from another bank) into their own account and their balance / transaction history isn't showing it or hasn't been updated yet; 'I made a transfer and my balance hasn't updated', 'where is the money I transferred', 'how long until a bank transfer shows up in my account'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money deposited (cheque/check, cash deposit, 'deposited some money', 'put money in') that hasn't been credited or reflected in the balance; also vague 'I already sent the money and it's not in my account', 'why hasn't my account updated', 'when will my balance reflect a deposit' when no bank transfer is mentioned.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Transfer cannot be made because it is 'not possible' or not allowed: error message saying the transfer isn't possible/won't go through although it worked before; beneficiary not allowed/blocked/denied/can't be added; 'why can't I transfer to a beneficiary/to an account'; transfer to a beneficiary or to one's own account that didn't process; the app won't allow a transfer/crypto/exchange purchase. Use this rather than failed_transfer when the customer says they got an error message that the transfer is not possible, or when a beneficiary/recipient account is the subject.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, reverse, or change a transfer or transaction just made, e.g. sent to the wrong account by mistake.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring soon or has expired: renewing/replacing it, new expiry date. Also asks for a new/replacement card to be sent to or received in China (messages that mention China and a new card).
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which merchants, shops, online, countries; whether it is valid everywhere.
criteria.card_arrival: Customer is waiting for a card that was sent and hasn't arrived (still not received, been a week); track the card you sent, has my card been sent, where is my new card; card delivery problem or tracking.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes or when it will be delivered: delivery to a specific country (the US, etc.), a specific delivery date, how soon, need the card ASAP/fast/expedited, 'when will my card come / when can I expect it', how long does a card take to arrive.
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card in the app, making a received or found card appear in the app, reactivating a previously lost/deactivated card that was found.
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card isn't working anymore / can't use my card / transactions don't go through with the card / card rejected in a restaurant; general card trouble focused on the card itself rather than a named payment, for which the wording is 'my card', 'physical card', 'can't use'.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for paying/using their card or for card payments ('fee for using my card', 'paid with my card and was charged', avoiding fees), or asks generally what fees exist; card payment fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment/charge on the card or in the app that the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make ('there is a payment in the app I didn't make', 'a couple of payments'); may also ask to freeze the card or to get the money back.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Payment/purchase (bought an item, made a purchase, a payment) with the wrong/bad exchange rate applied, charged a different rate, overcharged on rate; or complaining the exchange rate is bad/unfair and asking if it is the real interbank rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: Card was swallowed/eaten/stuck in an ATM or cash machine.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Asks about or complains about a fee/charge for an ATM cash withdrawal at home or in general, e.g. whether withdrawals are free, why a fee was added, free ATM withdrawals and limits; no mention of exchange rate or being abroad.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Cash withdrawal or money taken out in the app/statement that the customer did not make: 'a cash withdrawal that I didn't make', 'money missing', 'cash showing in my app I didn't take'; mentions cash, withdrawal or ATM explicitly.
criteria.change_pin: Changing/resetting the PIN: how do I change my PIN, at which ATMs, from abroad or remotely, whether I need to go to a bank.
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects someone is using or has accessed the card or card details without permission ('someone might be using my card', 'think someone has my details', card used without my permission); fraud concerns about the card itself, often not naming a specific payment or withdrawal.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments not working or how to set up contactless.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported or where service is available, and whether someone living in a given country (US, UK, EU) can get a card or open an account: 'can I get a card if I live in the US', 'what countries'.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined/rejected: messages saying 'card payment', 'payment was declined', new card declined in a shop/store, payment declined multiple times; ask why the payment was declined.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined / card not working at the ATM / couldn't get money out; 'my card was declined at the ATM', 'I can't withdraw'.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer, transfers, or purchase was declined: messages that mention 'transfer(s)' being declined, a decline message, repeatedly declined when trying to buy something online, recipient details checked but still declined.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A charge/debit/payment on the account that the customer did not make or authorise and that is described as a debit, direct debit, automatic debit, or money taken out by a seller/merchant/company; disputing or tracing such a debit or charge (wording like 'debit', 'seller', 'billing statement', 'dispute', 'a payment I didn't make'). If the message explicitly says 'card payment' or card purchase, it is card_payment_not_recognised instead.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions on disposable virtual cards: number per day, needing many disposable cards, who can request them, downsides, rules, transaction limits.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: address, name, phone, account details.
criteria.exchange_rate: Neutral question about what the current exchange rate is, how it is determined/calculated, which rate is used, what factors influence it; no complaint about a specific payment.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert/change money between currencies (e.g. USD, GBP, AUD) using the app; whether the app supports exchanging currencies; 'how do I exchange currencies', 'can I use this app for both USD and GBP'.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Extra charge on the statement: an extra pound/euro/dollar (e.g. one pound) appears on my statement, charged more than expected, unexplained charge on the statement, pending extra amount; focus on 'statement'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / was unsuccessful / 'didn't work' / couldn't be completed / keeps failing / asks if your system is broken (rent, mortgage, flat, paying friends); 'what went wrong with my transfer', asks why the transfer failed; no error message saying it is 'not possible' and no beneficiary mentioned.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported: which currencies can I hold/have in the account, holding multiple currencies, which currencies are supported or allowed, whether a specific currency such as EUR can be exchanged/held; list of currencies. The question is about which currencies (fiat) are available.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create/order a disposable virtual card, what disposable virtual cards are and what they are used for.
criteria.get_physical_card: PIN of the card or receiving the card: where to find/get my PIN, haven't received my PIN yet, how long until the PIN, how to see/set the card PIN, how to get my card's PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second/duplicate card, e.g. for a child; how many cards; fees for extra cards.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get/order/find a (non-disposable) virtual card; virtual card not received or not showing.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost, stolen or missing: block it, replace it, what to do.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost/stolen/left behind/replaced, or customer was mugged / everything (bag, belongings) was stolen and they can't use the app; securing the account or using the app without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order or get a physical/actual card, cost or charge for a physical card, where cards are delivered/shipped; asking how to get a card in general (not tied to a country of residence, not a spare card, not expiry).
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot/lost app passcode or password, cannot log in, reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment shows as pending / still pending / how long does a pending payment take; 'purchase is pending', 'what does pending mean'.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM shows as pending / not showing on the account.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending, how long will it take, hasn't gone through yet (even after an hour), not completed, funds not available yet, when will my top-up go through.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending / still pending / how long does a transfer stay pending; transfers that take time, e.g. EU transfers to a seller for something bought online, waiting for a transfer to clear, pending transaction/ outgoing transfer, account details were correct but still waiting.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked / too many wrong tries / forgot PIN and it's blocked; how to unblock.
criteria.receiving_money: How others (friend, employer) can send money to the account, receiving salary or payments, receiving payment in another currency (e.g. GBP), who can send money.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund expected from a merchant has not appeared in the account/statement yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to get a refund, return an item, cancel a purchase or stop a payment; refund policy.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was cancelled / reverted / returned / came back / terminated / not accepted / stopped, payment seemed to work but the money returned to the account, repeated online purchases where the payment comes back, 'my card payments have stopped'.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards/currencies/payment methods can be used to top up / add money: e.g. American Express/Amex, US cards, payment cards, foreign currencies accepted for adding money; 'how can I use American Express to add money'.
criteria.terminate_account: Close, delete, cancel, or shut down the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Will I be charged / what does it cost / is there a fee when topping up or receiving money by bank transfer, SEPA or SWIFT; general question about transfer charges or cost of transfers; whether SWIFT transfers are accepted.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees/charges for topping up with a card (international, US, European cards), whether top-up is free.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up by cash or cheque: can I, how, where; cheque deposit not allowed.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed / was declined / didn't work / not reflected; credit card declined when topping up; app denied the top-up, why did topping up fail.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on manual top-ups: maximum amount or number of top-ups per period, any amount allowed; not about auto top-up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/reversed, or the money disappeared/is gone after a top-up ('it was there and now it's gone'), crypto top-up problems, funds returned to bank account.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money / transfer money using a credit or debit card, how someone else can top up my account, the wallet doesn't show the top-up, top-up currently unknown.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge or payment / same transaction shown twice.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee/extra charge when transferring money or on a transfer they made (past event, 'why was I charged a fee for transferring', 'I thought transfers were free'), or a fee on payments abroad after moving overseas, or the recipient got less than sent.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my account from another bank or account; process/steps of a bank transfer to top up; 'how do I transfer money to my account'.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer sent to another person/recipient (friend, seller) has not arrived or been received by them: 'my friend hasn't received', account number checked, transfer within the country not received, the recipient can't see the money, why hasn't my transfer arrived, transferred money is missing.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes, especially a transfer arriving from a region (from China, from Europe, from the US, to the UK); expected transfer time, when a transfer will reach the account, how long will a transfer take, can it be faster. Mentions a region, or asks a general question about duration, without describing a specific transfer as missing or pending.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer is trying to verify their identity and it isn't working or they need help: can't verify, verification fails or takes long, the app won't identify them, help proving my identity, what do I need to do to prove my identity, identity verification results/document problems, 'help me verify my identification'.
criteria.verify_my_identity: General how-to questions about identity verification: what is the identity verification process, how do identity checks work, what documents/forms of ID are required, where in the app do I verify, steps for identity checks.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or seeing the source of funds / where money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up: verification code, verifying top-up card, why verification is needed.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card (incl. disposable virtual card) not working or rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing/getting one or both.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required/needed and what it is for: 'why do you need my ID', 'what is the identity check', 'how does identity verification work', whether the account can be used before/without verification, is verification mandatory, how long can I wait, bypassing it.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested/deducted: 'only gave me', 'the amount of cash was wrong', 'I asked for X and got Y'.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal/ATM related: got cash/withdrew abroad or on holiday and the exchange rate or amount charged was wrong, overcharged, very high fees for taking cash, 'exchange rate was wrong when I got cash/at the ATM', wrong rate when abroad.
